definitions.explanation: Counter for musical pieces or songs.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}を{聴|き}いてください。
{今日|きょう}は3{曲|きょく}{歌|うた}った。
{新|あたら}しいアルバムには10{曲|きょく}{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: There are ten songs on the new album.

notes:
{曲|きょく} functions both as a noun meaning "song/piece" and as a counter for musical pieces.

AS A NOUN:
- この{曲|きょく}: this song/piece
- いい{曲|きょく}: a good song
- {名|めい}{曲|きょく}: famous piece
- {新|しん}{曲|きょく}: new song

AS A COUNTER:
- 1{曲|きょく}: one song
- {何|なん}{曲|きょく}: how many songs?
- ～{曲目|きょくめ}: ~th song

COMPOUNDS:
- {作|さっ}{曲|きょく}: music composition
- {作|さっ}{曲家|きょくか}: composer
- {編|へん}{曲|きょく}: arrangement
- {選|せん}{曲|きょく}: song selection
- {持|も}ち{歌|うた}/レパートリー: repertoire

RELATED WORDS:
- {歌|うた}: song (general word)
- {音楽|おんがく}: music
